additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Mykonos · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Nineteen own-project renders cover the complete building, private/shared pools, court, lobby, kitchen, living rooms and bedrooms. All 17 native resources and six primary gallery assets were visually reviewed against the whole brochure. The Greek windmill photograph and generic/corporate or other-project pages are excluded. Page 42 shows a bedroom and is labeled accordingly. The current aerial render supplies the hero and listing card. Proposed views remain unit-unspecific.
review.floorPlans: Four complete official brochure sheets show studio, 1 BR, 2 BR and 3 BR pool layouts. Four complete building floorplates from Mitchell’s branded broker mirror cover floors 1–4. The mirror also contains rotated versions of the four home layouts. All source pages remain available in the original PDFs. Numerical home areas and contractual numbered-unit matching are not printed on the selected sheets. Confirm the selected home, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All four official home sheets on physical pages 45–48 and all eight mirror drawing pages 2–9 were visually reviewed in full. Four mirror home sheets show rotated versions and remain in the complete downloadable pack, with official versions used in the selector. Original backgrounds, notices, logos and floorplate content remain intact. No numerical area is inferred from drawings or a category minimum.
review.location: The complete local map on physical page 36 and regional map/travel panel on page 37 were visually reviewed. Both primary and original brochure identify Dubai Studio City. All seven printed destination estimates were transcribed with source scope. The two named airports remain distinct. The published name-only map query is saved with its primary HTML hash. No coordinate or entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML and brochure, native image origins and Mitchell’s complete branded floorplate/home PDF retain receipts and SHA256 checks. Broker hosting remains explicitly labeled. Complete source pages and original physical PDF-page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, contractual numbered-unit matching, exact visitor entrance coordinates, terminal-specific or current live journey times, final unit finishes/views and dated construction photographs were not established.
